description_en: Queries the information about the log analysis feature for a website, such as the feature status and the Simple Log Service project and Logstore that are used
description_zh: 例如开关状态、对接的日志项目、日志库
name: DescribeWebAccessLogStatus

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website.

A forwarding rule must be configured for the domain name. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html operation to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。
域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domain

SlsLogstore.description_zh: DDoS高防服务对接的日志库

SlsProject.description_en: The Log Service project of the instance
SlsProject.description_zh: DDoS高防服务对接的日志服务项目

SlsStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the Log Analysis feature is enabled for the website. Valid values:

true: enabled
false: disabled
SlsStatus.description_zh:
网站业务是否开启全量日志。取值：
true：已开启
false：未开启
